request: Investigate the hold-up on order ORD-1008.

steps.text: I am pulling the order details first to see its fulfillment status, promised date, warehouse, and items so I can choose the right next checks.
I am checking inventory at the Dallas warehouse (WH-DAL) for each line item to see if insufficient stock is holding up fulfillment.
I am checking other warehouses for SKU-303 to see if a single location can cover the shortfall of 10 units for a transfer.

arguments.summary: Fulfillment is on hold due to a shortage of SKU-303 at the Dallas warehouse; the other line item has sufficient stock. The order has not yet passed its promised delivery date.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1008 for Woodgrove Clinic, fulfillment_warehouse_id WH-DAL (Dallas Distribution Center), fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-17, is_past_promised_date false
check_inventory: SKU-303 at WH-DAL on_hand 22, reserved 2, available 20
check_inventory: SKU-606 at WH-DAL on_hand 250, reserved 0, available 250
find_alternative_stock: SKU-303 required_quantity 10, WH-BOS available 50 can_cover_required_quantity true; WH-ATL available 6 false; WH-CHI available 5 false
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient available inventory for SKU-303 at WH-DAL (short by 10 units versus the ordered quantity).
uncertainties: Whether a transfer from WH-BOS can arrive by 2026-03-17 is unknown from the available data.
arguments.recommendation: Request an immediate transfer of 10 units of SKU-303 from WH-BOS to WH-DAL and, to protect the delivery date, consider split-shipping the in‑stock SKU-606 now.
